body_markdown:
Cybersecurity is at the heart of autonomy.
As AI and robotics reshape the defense landscape, secure communications are no longer optional—they are mission-critical.


A new Streetwise Reports feature spotlights Mobilicom (NASDAQ: MOB), where Litchfield Hills Research initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a $10 price target. The report highlights how our end-to-end, cyber-protected drone and robotics solutions give defense organizations a trusted edge in adopting AI-powered autonomous systems.


With deployments across 70+ platforms worldwide, Mobilicom is uniquely positioned to drive secure autonomy at scale.
